assessment: Scientific review retained the source-supported vortex-number fit. The equilibration-time candidate was rejected because it conflated the crossing-relative delay with the source-reported absolute-time expression containing a linear crossing-time term. The two energy-spectrum candidates were rejected because they did not satisfy the executable contract. Public wording was de-identified, and the counterfactual exponent was authored outside the reported fit uncertainty; neither change is attributed to the paper.
